findings.entity: second white coffee mug (held by waitress) / man's mug
findings.description: Within one continuous shot (no cut between 01:09.08 and 01:17.5), the waitress holds a second white mug right next to the mug in the man's hand. At ~01:12.5 two distinct mugs are visible side by side. Over the next ~0.3 s they overlap and become a single mug in the man's hand. The waitress's hand stays extended but is visibly empty, and from 01:13 on only one mug is on the counter. One mug vanishes and nothing visible accounts for it: it is not set down, not taken away, and not handed off as a separate object.
